'''Gull Tuldok''' was a large booming [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] and [[Gambling/Legends|gambler]] who led one of [[Tuldok clan]]'s three raiding fleets. He had spent most of his life in [[Realspace/Legends|space]], returning to [[Recopia]] every five [[Standard year/Legends|years]] or so to resupply, take on new crew members, and visit his family.<ref name="CatCW" />
